scope: CUDA translation units and headers under vendored src and plugin, grouped by operations and consumers; not an exhaustive symbol/branch proof.

groups.operations: Native dense/columnar matrices; custom gradient pairs; native prediction placement; build information
groups.limits: Native Metal descriptors replace CUDA array-interface pointers. Native custom gradients retain device-authoritative Metal output even for CPU learners; host gradient arrays retain upstream CPU packing. CUDA device-selection guards are backend-specific; Metal ordinal validation is in Context.

groups.operations: Typed/strided tensors, masks, categorical columns, proxy setup and producer completion
groups.limits: Torch/MLX producers are synchronized; raw producers must provide completed buffers. CUDA stream events have no portable Metal stream-pointer counterpart. Scheduling is synchronous, not CUDA-equivalent.

groups.operations: Native sparse entry filtering, row counts/prefixes, CSR packing and ordinary matrix creation
groups.limits: CONFIRMED GAP: CUDA CopyToSparsePage sets the device for both arrays and packs entries through DeviceSpan. Metal CopyTensorToSparsePage uses host destination spans. CUDA explicitly publishes a host row-offset mirror to read the nonzero count; that mirror is intentional, but persistent entry storage remains missing. CudaSketchOnDMatrix and compressed PushCSR also request host entry spans; migrate these consumers together with the importer.

groups.operations: Typed metadata import/validation, query IDs, slicing, copy/extend and equality
groups.limits: Public ordinary DMatrix row slicing uses the host SparsePage path upstream too. Internal metadata gather is GPU tested; host group-size prefix and serialization are intentional.

groups.operations: Typed dictionary sort/search, recoding, device dictionary copies and sorted-index lifetime
In-memory and external quantile adapters, reference cuts, batch concatenation and bin assignment
groups.limits: Input-device inference and explicit fork construction options differ; CuPy CSR/CSC is unsupported in upstream Python and is not a missing native Metal interface.

groups.operations: Raw/adaptor quantile sketches: weights, sort, scan, categories, summaries, merge/prune and final cuts
groups.limits: GPU summary operations and CUDA-derived rank rules are covered. Scan association, sorting ties and rank repair remain documented numerical audit boundaries; final host cut publication matches CUDA.

groups.operations: Compressed pages, adaptive dense/sparse representations, copies/concatenation and CPU conversion
Disk/host external caches, prefetch, compressed page IO, regeneration and lifetime
groups.limits: Host/private Metal cache policies implement the data lifecycle; CUDA mmap advice/VMM/preload scheduling are not reproduced as CUDA APIs. External staging performance remains open.

groups.operations: Optional sparse-cache Snappy compression, headers, copy/literal decoding and decompression
groups.limits: Metal compute replaces nvCOMP and NVIDIA decompression-engine APIs. Internal block layout is port-specific; decoded payloads and rejection behavior are checked.

groups.operations: Typed host/device access states, fill/copy/resize/concatenate and lazy host mirrors
groups.limits: Typed bit-preserving storage is covered. A storage implementation existing does not prove every consumer uses it; vector-tree model buffers and ordinary native matrix entries remain confirmed gaps.

groups.operations: GPU/host allocation, pinned buffers, grow-only storage, mmap resources and buffer lifetime
groups.limits: Metal shared/private buffers and retained owners replace CUDA allocators, VMM and managed-memory advice. Resource/copy/lifetime consumers are tested; reservation and migration scheduling differ. RMM itself is CUDA-specific, not a Metal allocator.

groups.operations: Device context, stream completion, launch/error helpers, cached allocations and debug support
groups.limits: CUDA runtime and debug helpers are backend support, not separate public learning operations. Metal uses command buffers and synchronous completion. Exhaustive helper-caller auditing remains necessary.

groups.operations: Segmented sorting, sequences, scans, run-length encoding, compaction and trapezoid scheduling
groups.limits: Consumer-specific Metal kernels replace Thrust/CUB templates. This maps tested ranking/sketch/metadata/class-prior consumers, not a general replacement CUDA STL API. All template call sites still need reconciliation.

groups.operations: Uniform row sampling, weighted columns and source random distributions
groups.limits: Targets modern CUDA Philox4x64; the old Thrust fallback is a different stream. Unweighted column shuffle uses its separate Thrust-derived stream.

groups.operations: FP32 sums, binary64 optional weights, means/weighted means and medians/quantiles
groups.limits: Host scalar publication/global denominators follow source. Parallel association and independent transcendental libraries are not NVIDIA bitwise guarantees.

groups.operations: Class-prior small histograms, scaling, logarithms, centering and elementwise consumers
groups.limits: Production Transform/ElementWiseKernel/TransformKernel callers are reconciled in validation/cuda-metal-transform-callers.txt. Specialized Metal operations replace CUDA C++ lambda launchers; this does not certify every Thrust/CUB helper or numerical equality.

groups.operations: Regression/logistic/gamma/squared-log/pseudo-Huber/Poisson/Tweedie/expectile/absolute gradients, validation and transforms
groups.limits: Cox gradient and prediction exponential are host code upstream; its base-score log-margin converter dispatches Metal. Absolute/expectile host finalizers are intentional. Objective arithmetic is detailed in CUDA_PARITY.md.

groups.operations: Hinge/multiclass gradients, label checks, softmax/argmax and class-prior initialization
Quantile gradients, weighted initialization, prediction sorting and adaptive leaf updates
All AFT gradient rows, clipping/limits, PDF/CDF expressions and base-score/prediction transforms
groups.limits: All rows run on GPU, but sensitive-tail CPU numerical equivalence fails for part of the retained corpus (see cuda-aft-device-m3.txt). Expression/primitive checks are separate evidence, not an all-rows CPU equivalence claim.

groups.operations: Ranking caches/order, NDCG/MAP pairs, Philox sampling, gradients, normalization and unbiased learning
groups.limits: Source cost-factor race and nonfinite frexp inputs have explicit deterministic policies. Compiler contraction, scan/reduction association and long-run model differences remain documented limits.

groups.operations: Elementwise, multiclass and survival metric row formulas, validation, sums and scalar publication
Precision, NDCG and MAP ordering/prefixes/weights and cached ideal scores
groups.limits: Source arithmetic and degenerate queries are covered; reduction/scan association is architecture-dependent.

groups.operations: Binary/multiclass/grouped ROC and PR-AUC, summaries, normalization and distributed aggregation
groups.limits: Grouped ROC uses count-based accumulation rather than CUDA pair-scan association. Source pair terms and edge behavior are checked; cross-architecture floating-point equality is not established.

groups.operations: Per-group gradient copies, DART batch/inplace increments and tree-booster consumers
Output initialization, batch/inplace/leaf traversal, scalar/vector/category inputs, margins and caches
Exact contributions/interactions, leaf weights, path/basis construction and GPU accumulation
groups.limits: Source expression order and eight-point sums are checked. Cross-tree atomics and NVIDIA compiler behavior are unverified. Approximate SHAP and source host compression retain CPU execution.

groups.operations: Coordinate-descent reductions/residual updates and five host selector strategies
groups.limits: FP32 arithmetic follows CUDA; CUB association/contraction remains a limit. Selectors, scalar weight updates, CSC preparation and linear prediction remain host upstream.

groups.operations: Feature-interaction group unions/query/reset and GPU monotonic bounds
Newton stump gradient reduction and unregularized root weights
Global sign bounds, integer quantizers, uniform masks, gradient thresholds and value-gradient replay
groups.limits: Modern Philox target; global scales are source-defined. Reduction association and nonfinite policies are recorded in the detailed ledger.

groups.operations: Quantized dense/sparse histogram accumulation, subtraction/cache and feature-group launch scheduling
groups.limits: Metal launch tiling replaces CUDA feature grouping. Integer totals/cache semantics are checked; scheduling and throughput are not identical.

groups.operations: Numeric/categorical scalar split scans, missing direction, gains, weights and expansion state
groups.limits: Integer scans and CUDA-derived candidate ordering have independent source oracles; expansion metadata is host orchestration.

groups.operations: Multi-target split evaluation, per-target sums, reduced split/value gradients and category candidates
groups.limits: GPU arithmetic/state is mapped; persistent final vector-tree model containers are a separate confirmed gap.

groups.operations: Stable row partition, compressed-page reads and leaf-position output
Reduced-gradient sampling replay, leaf/page integer sums and final weights
Batched model weight/category copies, root assignment and learning-rate scaling
groups.limits: CONFIRMED GAP: MPS CopyBatch/ApplyLearningRate use HostSpan/ConstHostSpan and host alias snapshots. CUDA selects DeviceSpan and device-to-device copies. SetRoot tests only IsCUDA. GPU arithmetic tests do not establish persistent Metal model storage.

groups.operations: Hist/approx scalar/vector learners, forests, cache updates, adaptive leaves and manual selection
groups.limits: Common updater classes dispatch Metal. Manual names and configuration lifetime are covered. Pipeline completeness still depends on the open vector-model storage and caller audits.

groups.operations: Fixed allreduce/broadcast/allgather and variable allgather, arithmetic and backend state
groups.limits: Shared Metal payloads use TCP transport and GPU local arithmetic, replacing NCCL transport. Multiple local workers are tested; cross-machine and NVIDIA comparisons are not.

groups.operations: Ordered variable payload reductions and distributed sketch merging
groups.limits: TCP tree order and federated ascending host-fallback order are tested separately with non-associative witnesses.

groups.operations: Federated fixed collectives, shared RPC ordering, GPU ordered sketch fallback and learners
groups.limits: Fixed arithmetic executes on the server as with CUDA. Server type/operator restrictions are preserved; local-process and TLS tests are not cross-machine fault-tolerance evidence.
